name: layerorder-simple
description: IXT-SUITES batch 4: layerOrder (simple) flag — Bring to front / Send to back rows in the right-click ContextMenu reorder the `items` array (render z-order). On in both Simple and Pro (simple-tier, always on).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-on
steps.failMessage: layerOrder should be on (default true, simple tier) in Simple mode

steps.name: seed-items
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const ids = []; ids.push(s.addItem({ defId: 'coffee-table', position: [10.55, 4.1], rotation: 0, props: {} })); ids.push(s.addItem({ defId: 'coffee-table', position: [10.6, 4.15], rotation: 0, props: {} })); ids.push(s.addItem({ defId: 'coffee-table', position: [10.65, 4.2], rotation: 0, props: {} })); window.__layerIds = ids; })()

steps.name: assert-initial-order
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const order = s.items.map(i => i.id); const idxA = order.indexOf(window.__layerIds[0]); const idxB = order.indexOf(window.__layerIds[2]); if (!(idxA < idxB)) throw new Error('expected seed order first < last, got ' + idxA + ' ' + idxB); })()

steps.name: open-ctx-front
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().openContextMenu({ x: 200, y: 200, target: { kind: 'item', id: window.__layerIds[0] } })

steps.name: ctx-visible
steps.failMessage: context menu did not open for the item target

steps.name: assert-front
steps.failMessage: item should now be last in the array (front / top of stack) after 'Bring to front'

steps.name: open-ctx-back
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().openContextMenu({ x: 200, y: 200, target: { kind: 'item', id: window.__layerIds[0] } })

steps.name: assert-back
steps.failMessage: item should now be first in the array (back / bottom of stack) after 'Send to back'

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: layerOrder is simple-tier — should remain on in Pro too
